meta.title: About

aboutPage.title: The axis your growth turns on

nameSection.title: Where the name comes from
nameSection.body1: In Latin, cardo means hinge — or axis. In a Roman city, the cardo maximus was the main north-south street everything else was built around: neighborhoods, markets, side streets. Everything oriented itself against that one axis.
nameSection.body2: That's the idea behind the agency. For a local service business, paid advertising isn't just one channel among many — it's often the axis the whole business's growth turns on. When that axis works, the schedule fills up. When it doesn't, nothing else quite makes up for it.

whySection.title: Why only paid advertising
whySection.body1: Most agencies sell a bit of everything: social media, SEO, branding, newsletters, ads. That's good for their revenue. It's rarely good for you, because nobody on the team is truly excellent at any one thing — and your ad budget ends up paying for someone's learning curve.
whySection.body2: Cardo only manages Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. No reels, no blog posts, no site redesigns. That limit is deliberate: it forces us to be better at one thing, and it gives you a simple way to judge us — cost per lead, and nothing else.

founderSection.title: The founder
founderSection.name: Étienne Roy
founderSection.body: Étienne spent six years managing Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts inside Montreal generalist agencies, watching colleagues sell content and SEO to clients who mostly just needed more phone calls. He founded Cardo on a bet that an agency that refuses to do everything might finally do one thing well. Today he personally oversees every account — no junior touches your budget without him in the loop.
